description: What finished, failed, was blocked or reported on each of your machines since a time. Use it to catch up after a while, or to see what happened since you last looked. Machines that don't answer are listed as unknown. Answers take a few seconds: other machines are asked at their next refresh.

since.description: The `since` the last gruntas_status or gruntas_changes returned, which holds each machine's own clock; or an RFC 3339 time.

name: gruntas_changes
